policy: Catalog all newly observed empirical failures in V3.3.1 without altering historical V3.3.0 or V3.2.1 failure records.

failures.description: Nominal out-of-sample coverage point estimate remains below 95.0% target under condition-aware Model D (observed 93.67% vs 95.00% target).
failures.trigger: Unseen sensor noise distributions in heavy occlusion pallet staging areas.
failures.observed_behavior: While 95% CI [91.55%, 95.28%] spans the target, the point estimate does not reach 95.00%, leaving a 1.33% nominal undercoverage residual.
failures.safety_impact: Slight coordinate undercoverage under heavy occlusion if autonomous braking is triggered at full confidence.
failures.mitigation_notes: Mitigated by RefusalQualityEngine gating heavy occlusion (>60%) to ADVISORY_WARNING_ONLY state.

failures.description: Continuous parallel walking of workers in identical high-vis PPE sustains an ambiguous identity state beyond 3 seconds.
failures.trigger: Two workers walking side-by-side within 0.6m in identical PPE for prolonged duration (>75 frames).
failures.observed_behavior: Engine maintains UNKNOWN_AMBIGUOUS_PAIR state, preventing track resolution until spatial divergence occurs.
failures.safety_impact: Autonomous personalized hazard warning is suppressed to generic advisory broadcast.
failures.mitigation_notes: Explicitly bounded by ODD policy: dense co-walking with identical attire is designated DEGRADED_ODD, enforcing advisory audio warnings.

failures.description: Spatio-temporal spillover lag in physical one-way aisle restriction delays downstream hazard manifestation.
failures.trigger: Vehicles diverted from one-way aisle accumulate at downstream junction 15 seconds after intervention onset.
failures.observed_behavior: Immediate pre/post window fails to capture delayed downstream queue formation without extended evaluation horizon.
failures.safety_impact: Risk of underestimating secondary backfire hazard if observation window is truncated prematurely.
failures.mitigation_notes: Added to active evidence gap matrix (GAP_V3_3_06) requiring extended longitudinal recording horizons.
